newsitem.title: USA: Sept Brent crude rises in late U.S. paper trading.
newsitem.headline: Sept Brent crude rises in late U.S. paper trading.

text.p: North Sea Brent crude oil rose in late U.S. paper trading on Monday, with a Wall Street trader once again attributed with most of the buying, traders said.
Two full boats of September Brent changed hands at $19.54 a barrel, up nine cents from the close of London's International Petroleum Exchange (IPE).
Two partial cargoes of 100 lots apiece also traded at $19.54 a barrel.
August/September Brent traded twice, at plus 30 and plus 31 cents a barrel, down from a range of 35-50 cents earlier in the day.
September/October traded at flat, within the day's earlier range.
October/November was pegged at minus six to minus four cents a barrel.
